questions.prompt: What does «Это наш главный вопрос» mean in English?
questions.explain: Главный means main or chief, and the masculine ending matches вопрос.

questions.prompt: Pick the correctly-agreeing form: «Главн__ улица очень красивая» (улица is feminine).
questions.explain: Улица is feminine, so the adjective takes the feminine ending -ая: главная.

questions.prompt: Which form fits the neuter noun: «Это главн__ правило игры» (правило is neuter)?
questions.explain: Правило is neuter, so главный takes the neuter ending -ое: главное.

questions.prompt: How would you say "She is a well-known singer" in Russian?
questions.explain: Певица is feminine, so известный takes the feminine ending -ая: известная певица.

questions.prompt: What does «Обед уже готов» mean in English?
questions.explain: Готов is the short-form masculine predicate stating that обед is in a ready state.

questions.prompt: A female speaker says she is ready to go to work. Which short form is correct: «Я готов__ идти на работу»?
questions.explain: A female speaker uses the feminine short form готова.

questions.prompt: What does «Это известный русский писатель» mean in English?
options: This is a famous Russian writer.
This is an old Russian writer.
This is a young Russian writer.
This is a poor Russian writer.
questions.explain: Известный means well-known or famous, and русский marks the writer as Russian.

questions.prompt: Choose the form agreeing with the plural noun: «Это наши главн__ цели» (цели is plural).
questions.explain: Цели is plural, so the adjective takes the plural ending -ые: главные.

questions.prompt: What does «У нас общий друг» mean in English?
questions.explain: Общий means common or shared, so a общий друг is a mutual friend.

questions.prompt: Why is it «У них общая цель» and not «общий цель»?
options: цель is feminine, so the adjective takes -ая
цель is masculine, so the adjective takes -ая
цель is plural, so the adjective takes -ая
цель is neuter, so the adjective takes -ая
questions.explain: Цель is a feminine noun, so общий agrees with the feminine ending -ая: общая.

questions.prompt: What does «Он работал целый день» mean in English?
questions.explain: Целый means whole or entire, and целый день is an accusative expression of duration.

questions.prompt: Pick the feminine accusative form for duration: «Я ждал тебя цел__ неделю» (неделю is feminine accusative).
questions.explain: Неделю is feminine accusative, so целый takes the feminine accusative ending -ую: целую.

questions.prompt: What does «Пушкин - великий поэт» mean in English?
questions.explain: Великий means great, and the masculine ending matches поэт.

questions.prompt: Choose the form agreeing with the neuter noun: «Это велик__ открытие науки» (открытие is neuter).
questions.explain: Открытие is neuter, so великий takes the neuter ending -ое: великое.

questions.prompt: What does «Это очень нужный совет» mean in English?
options: This is a very useful piece of advice.
This is a very long piece of advice.
This is a very strange piece of advice.
This is a very simple piece of advice.
questions.explain: Нужный means needed or useful, and the masculine ending matches совет.

questions.prompt: How would you say "This is a necessary step forward" in Russian (шаг is masculine)?
questions.explain: Шаг is masculine, so необходимый takes the masculine ending: необходимый шаг.

questions.prompt: Why does «Я встретил известного актёра» use the ending -ого?
options: актёр is animate masculine in the accusative, which copies the genitive -ого
актёр is feminine in the accusative, taking -ого
актёр is neuter in the prepositional, taking -ого
актёр is plural in the dative, taking -ого
questions.explain: For an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive, so известный becomes известного.

questions.prompt: What does «Это единственный возможный вариант» mean in English?
options: This is the only possible option.
This is the best possible option.
This is the last possible option.
This is the first possible option.
questions.explain: Возможный means possible, and with единственный the sentence names the only possible option.

questions.prompt: In «Это вполне возможно», what does возможно mean?
questions.explain: Возможно is the neuter short form used impersonally to mean it is possible.

questions.prompt: Pick the form agreeing with the plural noun: «Эти меры необходим__ для безопасности» (меры is plural, short form).
questions.explain: Меры is plural, so the short-form predicate takes the plural ending -ы: необходимы.
